info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Trials-v2-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscription Trials API allows developers to access and list available trial subscriptions for streaming services. This API provides an overview of the subscription trials that users can potentially engage with, enhancing user experience and decision-making. Typical consumers include developers integrating subscription models into their applications or services seeking to promote streaming trial offerings. By leveraging this API, both developers and businesses can efficiently monitor and evaluate available streaming subscription trials.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all trial subscriptions associated with your account. It provides detailed information about each subscription's status and usage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of trial subscriptions. It expects the necessary parameters to be included in the request payload, formatted as JSON.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsRequest.title: Subscription Trial Operations GET Request Body
ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the GET operation related to subscription trials.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsResponse.title: Subscription Trial Response

status.description: Indicates whether the subscription trial operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the subscription trial operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the subscription trial operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription trial.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time for the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation result.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsTrialsResponse.description: A response object returned when retrieving the subscription trial status.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the subscription trial.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the subscription trial was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the subscription trial operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details about the creation and automation of the subscription trial operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time in milliseconds that the server spent processing the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing completed almost instantaneously.
